We are looking for a savvy, results-driven Sales Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for our Go-To-Market (GTM) functions, sourcing and hiring top-tier sales talent, account executives, and alliance managers who understand how to sell cloud professional services.

The ideal candidate brings extensive background navigating fast-paced professional services environments and possesses the strategic mindset required to build strong talent pipelines that align with our global growth strategy.

End-to-End Talent Acquisition: Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for GTM positions, including Senior Account Executives, VP-level Alliance roles, and business development positions across our AWS and Salesforce practices.
Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, sales leadership, and executive stakeholders to define role requirements, profile ideal candidates, and align hiring strategies with business goals.
Strategic Sourcing: Utilize advanced sourcing strategies, data-driven tools, and direct outreach to uncover and engage passive candidates in a highly competitive cloud ecosystem.
Candidate Experience: Ensure an exceptional, transparent, and seamless candidate experience from initial outreach through the final offer presentation.
Market Intelligence: Stay abreast of cloud consulting, professional services, and SaaS hiring trends to counsel hiring managers on market reality, compensation expectations, and talent mapping.
Collaborate Globally: Partner closely with the broader Employee Success and HR business partner teams to scale recruiting operations and uphold AllCloud’s culture of excellence.
Compensation & Offer Structuring: Partner with HR and Compensation teams to navigate complex executive offers, including intricate commission structures, OTE (On-Target Earnings).

5+ Years of GTM Recruiting Background: Proven track record of successfully filling complex sales, account management, and alliance roles within the technology or consulting sectors.
Headhunting Expert: Advanced competency in executive headhunting methodologies, moving beyond LinkedIn InMails to leverage personal networks, referrals, and industry mapping.
Professional Services Expertise: Heavy experience recruiting within a professional services, IT consulting, cloud partner ecosystem (AWS, Salesforce, or similar), or specialized SaaS environment.
Advanced Sourcing Capabilities: Demonstrated expert-level skill in leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter, AI, and alternative tech talent networks to source specialized sales talent.
Exceptional Communication: Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to confidently advise executive-level leaders.
Agility & Drive: Ability to manage a dynamic requisition workload, adapt to evolving business priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

When you become part of the AllCloud family, every day is an opportunity to work with one of today’s fastest-growing technology ecosystems. We believe that building a meaningful career requires balance—giving back to your community, enhancing your skill set, and taking time away. Our comprehensive benefits include:
Flexible work-from-home options and remote trust working hours
Comprehensive healthcare and competitive compensation with performance bonuses
Generous vacation package

A creative and inclusive global atmosphere that empowers you to bring your own ideas to life

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

This is a high-ownership venture-building role for our first dedicated Talent Acquisition hire. You won't just fill open roles, you'll build telli's Talent Acquisition function from second zero and own our ability to get A-players through the door across every team.
The team we've built so far is exceptional, and we hire to a very high bar. This role is about scaling the team fast without dropping the bar.
You'll think AI-first wherever humans aren't needed, and build real systems wherever they are. You're highly versed (or learn fast) in building agents and automating away every workflow that can be, and you're data-first, always seeing the magic behind the numbers and deriving your case from it.

Business first, then think backwards: figure out what the business actually needs, then go build it
Build a real talent engine from scratch: sourcing, screening, closing
Obsess over pulling in the best profiles on the market, nothing below the bar
We're heading into serious growth soon, build a hiring engine that scales with it

Solid analytical skills with strong attention to detail.

High level of accuracy and reliability.

Die Region verfügt über eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direkten Bahnverbindungen nach Zürich und anderen wichtigen Wirtschaftszentren. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Freienbach durch sein innovatives Gewerbegebiet, die hohe Lebensqualität und die Nähe zum See, was eine attraktive Arbeitsumgebung für anspruchsvolle Fachkräfte schafft.
**Einsatzort:** Wallisellen und umgebung Freienbach
**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
Med Ipersonal ist ein auf die Vermittlung von Fachkräften in der Medizinbranche spezialisiertes Temporärbüro, das sich durch eine professionelle und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise auszeichnet.
**Über uns:**
Die MediPersonal AG ist ein modernes, wachsendes Personalberatungsunternehmen, das mit innovativen Konzepten und einer zukunftsorientierten Arbeitsweise neue Impulse auf dem Schweizer Markt setzt.
Unser Standort in Zürich zeichnet sich durch ein hochmodernes Arbeitsumfeld, erstklassige digitale Tools und flache Hierarchien aus. Wir verstehen uns als strategische Partner unserer Kunden und begleiten sie mit maßgeschneiderten Lösungen in der Personalgewinnung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine/n erfahrene/n Personalberater/in & Personalvermittler/in mit Schwerpunkt Medizin.
**Ihre Aufgaben:**
· **Rekrutierung von medizinischem Fachpersonal:**
Sie übernehmen den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess von der Profildefinition über die Direktansprache bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung von Ärzten, Pflegefachkräften und weiteren medizinischen Fachspezialisten. Besonders, wenn Personalberater für die Medizinbranche gesucht werden, sind effiziente Prozesse entscheidend.
· **Beratung und Betreuung von Kunden:**
Durch Ihre Marktkenntnisse und Ihr Gespür für die Bedürfnisse Ihrer Auftraggeber beraten Sie Kliniken, Spitäler, Gesundheitszentren sowie Praxen professionell und erarbeiten individuelle Lösungsansätze.
· **Aufbau und Pflege eines erstklassigen Kandidatennetzwerks:**
Mit Fingerspitzengefühl nutzen Sie Ihr Netzwerk, Social-Media-Kanäle und Jobportale, um Top-Kandidatinnen und -Kandidaten für anspruchsvolle Vakanzen zu finden.
· **Marktbeobachtung und Innovationsförderung:**

A propos du rôle
Don't leave fit to chance!
Chez Academic Work, nous sommes les experts du marché des professionnels en début de carrière, avec une ambition claire : connecter les talents aux entreprises qui feront leur succès.
Depuis plus de 15 ans, nous déployons notre expertise dans toute la Suisse, faisant de nous un partenaire de choix pour nos clients. Aujourd'hui, notre bureau genevois a besoin d'un soutien temporaire et c'est pourquoi nous recherchons Consultant\-e en Recrutement pour rejoindre notre équipe pour une période de 4 mois, potentiellement prolongeable.
Notre bureau est un mélange unique de dynamisme, de compétition, d'ambition et de bonne humeur, où chaque membre joue un rôle essentiel. Ce qui nous distingue ? Une culture d'entreprise forte, une orientation résultats sans compromis, des processus redoutablement bien huilés, et un engagement sincère envers nos candidats et clients.
Prêt/e à relever le défi ?
Tâches
En tant que Consultant\-e en Recrutement, tu seras le chef d'orchestre de tes processus, du recueil du besoin client jusqu'à l'accompagnement de tes candidats en mission. Concrètement, ton quotidien s'articulera autour de ces tâches :
Stratégie \& conseil client : échanger directement avec nos clients (en binôme avec l'Account Manager) pour comprendre leurs besoins. Loin d'être un simple exécutant, tu assumes un rôle d'expert pour les challenger et les orienter vers la meilleure stratégie d'acquisition.
Copywriting \& attraction : rédiger des annonces immersives, transparentes et ciblées. Fini le jargon purement corporate : tu parles le langage de nos candidats pour te démarquer et attirer les meilleurs talents.
Assessment \& sélection : conduire les entretiens et évaluer les candidats avec la rigueur de nos standards, en t'appuyant sur nos méthodes de recrutement scientifiques. Tu deviendras un\-e expert\-e dans l'analyse de nos tests psychométriques et cognitifs pour identifier le vrai potentiel au\-delà du simple CV.
Closing \& négociation : élaborer des dossiers complets et défendre tes profils face aux clients avec conviction. Tu utiliseras les données scientifiques de tes évaluations comme un levier pour convaincre tes clients de miser sur le potentiel, tout en menant les négociations (salariales, conditions) d'une main de maître.
Onboarding \& partenariat : Garantir un suivi administratif irréprochable (contrats, permis, certificats, etc.). Sur le terrain, tu deviens le career partner de tes consultants, avec ce qu'il faut de fermeté et de bienveillance pour maintenir des relations durables.
Ton profil
Expérience : 0 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle, idéalement en contact avec des clients (stages et jobs étudiants).
Langues : Une maîtrise parfaite du français (langue maternelle) ainsi qu'un très bon niveau d'anglais (C1 minimum).
Digital native dans l'âme, tu es autonome et tu jongles avec les outils informatiques avec curiosité.

## A propos du rôle ##
**Don-t leave fit to chance!**
Chez Academic Work, nous sommes les experts du marché des professionnels en début de carrière, avec une ambition claire : connecter les talents aux entreprises qui feront leur succès.
Depuis plus de 15 ans, nous déployons notre expertise dans toute la Suisse, faisant de nous un partenaire de choix pour nos clients. Aujourd-hui, notre bureau genevois a besoin d-un soutien temporaire et c-est pourquoi nous recherchons un.e **Consultant·e en Recrutement** pour rejoindre notre équipe pour une période de 4 mois, potentiellement prolongeable.
Notre bureau est un mélange unique de dynamisme, de compétition, d-ambition et de bonne humeur, où chaque membre joue un rôle essentiel. Ce qui nous distingue ? Une culture d-entreprise forte, une orientation résultats sans compromis, des processus redoutablement bien huilés, et un engagement sincère envers nos candidats et clients.
Prêt/e à relever le défi ?
## Tâches ##
En tant que Consultant·e en Recrutement, tu seras le chef d'orchestre de tes processus, du recueil du besoin client jusqu-à l-accompagnement de tes candidats en mission. Concrètement, ton quotidien s'articulera autour de ces tâches :
* **Stratégie & conseil client :** échanger directement avec nos clients (en binôme avec l'Account Manager) pour comprendre leurs besoins. Loin d'être un simple exécutant, tu assumes un rôle d'expert pour les challenger et les orienter vers la meilleure stratégie d'acquisition.
* **Copywriting & attraction :** rédiger des annonces immersives, transparentes et ciblées. Fini le jargon purement corporate : tu parles le langage de nos candidats pour te démarquer et attirer les meilleurs talents.
* **Assessment & sélection :** conduire les entretiens et évaluer les candidats avec la rigueur de nos standards, en t'appuyant sur nos méthodes de recrutement scientifiques. Tu deviendras un·e expert·e dans l'analyse de nos tests psychométriques et cognitifs pour identifier le vrai potentiel au-delà du simple CV.
* **Closing & négociation :** élaborer des dossiers complets et défendre tes profils face aux clients avec conviction. Tu utiliseras les données scientifiques de tes évaluations comme un levier pour convaincre tes clients de miser sur le potentiel, tout en menant les négociations (salariales, conditions) d'une main de maître.
* **Onboarding & partenariat :** Garantir un suivi administratif irréprochable (contrats, permis, certificats, etc.). Sur le terrain, tu deviens le *career partner* de tes consultants, avec ce qu'il faut de fermeté et de bienveillance pour maintenir des relations durables.
## Ton profil ##
* **Expérience :** 0 à 3 ans d-expérience professionnelle, idéalement en contact avec des clients (stages et jobs étudiants).
* **Langues :** Une maîtrise parfaite du français (langue maternelle) ainsi qu-un très bon niveau d-anglais (C1 minimum).
* Digital native dans l-âme, tu es autonome et tu jongles avec les outils informatiques avec curiosité.
**Ton ADN (ce qui fera ton succès chez nous) :**
* Tu as une attention redoutable aux détails. Là où d'autres se noient sous l'administratif, tu t'appuies sur des process clairs pour rester hyper-efficace.
* Drivé·e par les résultats, tu sais garder le cap et ton sang-froid même quand la pression monte, que les délais sont courts ou que les plans changent à la dernière minute.
* Tu ne te contentes pas de dire "oui". Tu as l'aplomb nécessaire pour défendre tes convictions face à un client exigeant.

# Personalberater/in RAV 80 - 100% #
Im Kanton Zürich führt das Amt für Arbeit 14 Regionale Arbeitsvermittlungszentren (RAV). In unseren RAV bieten wir ein umfassendes Dienstleistungsangebot für Stellensuchende und Arbeitgebende aus allen Branchen und Berufsgruppen an. Zudem unterstützen wir die Unternehmen bei der Suche nach den passenden Mitarbeitenden. Hier, am Puls des Arbeitsmarkts, sind Ihr Engagement und Ihre Berufskenntnisse gefragt.
In verschiedenen RAV des Kantons Zürich suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung kompetente und beratungsstarke Unterstützung.
### Das sind ihre Aufgaben ###
* Effiziente und zielgerichtete Wiedereingliederung von stellensuchenden Personen in den Arbeitsmarkt, inklusive systematischer Erfolgsmessung
* Durchführung von Standortbestimmungen, Entwicklung von Integrationsstrategien sowie Nachverfolgung der Zielerreichung
* Führen von Beratungsgesprächen mit Personen mit unterschiedlichen beruflichen und sozialen Hintergründen, inkl. Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Situationen
* Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben (AVIG) und Wahrnehmung der Kontrollfunktion
* Aufbau und Pflege eines belastbaren Netzwerks zu RAV-Partnerinstitutionen (Stellenmeldezentrum, Arbeitslosenkassen, Berufsberatung, Sozialhilfe etc.)
* Aktive Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitgebern im Raum Zürich zur Förderung nachhaltiger Vermittlungen
* Präzise administrative Fallführung (ca. 50 % der Tätigkeit)
### Das bringen Sie mit ###
* Abgeschlossene Berufsbildung mit EFZ und mindestens 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem beratungsintensiven Umfeld (z.B. HR, Recruiting, Personalberatung, Kundenbetreuung, Vertrieb mit klarer Beratungskompetenz, Arbeitsmarktintegration, Coaching oder Case Management)
* Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, anspruchsvolle Beratungssituationen zu führen und Menschen strukturiert durch Veränderungsprozesse zu begleiten
* Freude an einer Tätigkeit, die Beratung und Administration gleichermassen umfasst (ca. 50 % administrative Fallführung)
* Gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Arbeitsmarkts
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1), gute Englischkenntnisse
* Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, viele Prozesse gleichzeitig zu steuern und klar zu kommunizieren
### Das erwartet Sie bei uns ###
* Sorgfältige und fundierte Einführung im Rahmen unserer internen Erstausbildung zur/zum Personalberater/in RAV
* Unterstützung bei der Ausbildung zur/zum HR-Fachfrau/mann mit eidg. Fachausweis (sowohl finanziell als auch zeitlich)
* Eine anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, einer sinnstiftenden Aufgabe nachzugehen
* Gut ausgebaute Sozialleistungen nach kantonalem Personalrecht und einen Beitrag an die Verpflegungskosten (Lunch-Check)

Albert helps chemists change the world by building technology that understands how they work. As chemists ourselves, we know what it’s like when software doesn’t work the way you do — stuck with systems built by people who never spent a day at the bench. That’s why we created Albert OS, the first AI-native operating system for materials science, designed to remove every obstacle between curiosity and discovery.
We're looking for an ambitious and results-driven Talent Partner to join our growing team. This role, with a focus on building and scaling Albert's talent acquisition function, will play a key part in driving how we find, attract, and close the people who will define what Albert becomes.
If you're passionate about cutting-edge technology and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, we want to hear from you.

Build
Talent Experience: Candidacy at Albert feels intentional and distinct — because how Albert hiresreflectswhat Albert values. Own the full candidate journey — communications, interview process, offer experience — and curate every touchpoint to reflect that. Partner with Marketing and the People team to shape candidate-facing messaging and define what makes Albert a compelling place to work, so the experience a candidate has is never accidental and rarely forgettable.
Infrastructure: A hiring function that runs consistently and absorbs volume without constant manual intervention. Configure ATS workflows, build sourcing frameworks, andestablishthe data and reporting thatkeepthe system honest.
Tools, Automation & AI: Recruiting work runs more efficiently because you designed it that way.Identify, deploy, and manage the tools and agents that remove friction — and think critically about where automation adds value and where human judgment is irreplaceable.
Source
Outbound Recruiting: The right people choose Albert because you found them and made a compelling case. Lead deep outbound sourcing for Build org roles — AI engineers, software architects, product managers, and designers — with the craft and persistence these roles require.
Compliance & Fairness: Every hiring decision is consistent and compliant. Develop andmaintainstructured interview frameworks, evaluation criteria, and hiring guidelines that work across all roles and in partnership with recruiting teams globally.
Partner
Executive & Hiring Manager Partnership: Albert makes better hires because of the structure and perspective you bring. Consult on role and process design, enable structured interview practices, and bring informed points of view — not just execution.
Global TA Ecosystem: Alberthires withconsistency and credibility across every region. Build and coordinate the broader talent acquisition infrastructure across the US, Germany, India, and Japan — partnering with both external recruiting agencies and internal recruiters toestablishshared global practices, policies, and standards.
You will have
5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with depth in technical roles — AI engineering, software architecture, product management, and design.
Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving a recruiting function, not just executing within one.
Hands-on use of AI tools, ATS automation, or recruiting technology to solve real problems.
Startup or high-growth company experience — comfortable creatingstructurewhere none exists.
Global recruiting exposure with strong US market knowledge.
Experience working with and influencing senior executives who move fast.
Strong communicationacross candidates, hiring managers, and leadership.
A track recordof closing — not justsourcing butpersuading the right people to say yes.
Key Competencies
Autonomy: Does not wait to be asked. Creates their own path, follows up without prompting, takes full ownership of their work, and holds themselves accountable when things do not go as planned.
Builder mindset: Has worked in environments without a playbook and made something from nothing. Energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it.
AI fluency: Thinks critically about what belongs to a system and what belongs to a human. Uses AItools practically, not performatively.
Candidate empathy: Designs recruiting experiences the waya great productdesigner thinks about users — with care, intentionality, and a genuine interest in how people feel.
Strategic partnership: Earnstrust with executives and hiring managers by bringing informed points of view, not just executing requests.
Creativity: Thinks beyond job boards and standard outreach. Brings original ideas to how Albert attracts talent — how we tell our story, where we show up, and what makes a candidate choose us over a better-known name.
Grit: Persistent, resilient, and genuinely invested in outcomes. Does not mistake movement for progress.
Why Albert?
We have a huge impact. Albert is a growing team with a global reach. We're building toward a future where discovery feels like exploration, not administration. Where chemists can pursue their most ambitious ideas without friction.
We love our global team. Albert's home-base is in the California Bay Area, but we have multiple offices and employees sprinkled around the globe: India, Germany and Japan. In fact, over 50% of our employees work outside of California! An international hybrid culture is in our DNA. We care about you.

Albert works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We work hard and we play hard. We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us.

We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful — every day. We're always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Albert team. If you think you might be a fit, please apply!

Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d) 80-100%
* Full-time
Company Description
Wüest Partner is an innovative and independent software and service company in the real estate industry. Since 1985, we have been creating sound decision-making foundations by combining real estate expertise, data, and digital solutions. As an industry leader, we shape the future of the real estate sector together with our clients - offering comprehensive services in valuation, consulting, data, analytics, AI, software, sustainability, and education.
The Wüest Partner Group employs around 500 people at 15 locations across Europe, with its headquarters in Switzerland. The group includes the subsidiaries Durable, Datahouse, Qualicasa, and Signa-Terre.
Job Description
Your Team & Mission
Recruiting is much more to us than just filling open positions - it is a crucial success factor for our growth. As part of our Human Resources Department, you will become a member of our Talent Acquisition & Development team and be responsible for operational recruiting in Switzerland and our international locations. You will work closely with our managers, HR business partners, and HR services, actively shaping recruitment success.
Together, we create a positive employee experience - from attracting new talent to developing our employees. With your experience, entrepreneurial thinking, and advisory skills, you ensure that we attract the right talent even in a dynamic environment.
Due to an upcoming maternity leave in our team, we are now looking for reinforcement and look forward to an experienced individual who will help us further develop Talent Acquisition and contribute to the future expansion of our department.
Your Tasks
* You are responsible for the entire recruiting process (end-to-end) for positions in Switzerland as well as at our international locations.
* You advise and coach hiring managers as a competent sparring partner and support them in making well-founded recruitment decisions, ensuring a smooth recruiting process.
* You develop targeted search strategies together with the specialist departments and implement them independently.
* You actively identify and approach suitable talents via various channels (active sourcing).
* You ensure an excellent candidate experience and professionally accompany candidates throughout the entire application process.
* You collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and manage to advise and convince in a solution-oriented manner even in challenging situations.
* You analyse recruiting metrics, identify optimisation potentials, and contribute ideas for the continuous development of our recruiting processes and employer branding activities.

Your Profile
* At least five years of experience in in-house talent acquisition as well as experience recruiting for Switzerland and ideally for international locations.
* Completed studies (FH/university) or comparable education and training with a focus on human resources, business administration, or psychology.
* Active sourcing is second nature to you, and you use modern recruiting methods purposefully.
* You bring strong advisory skills and manage to professionally coach or challenge hiring managers and navigate confidently in a diverse stakeholder environment.
* You work independently, prioritise confidently, and take responsibility for your topics.
* You think entrepreneurially, recognise opportunities, and implement pragmatic solutions.
* Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken.
Additional Information

* Attractive employment conditions with a variable compensation component
* Flexible Work Smart concept with home office option
* Refreshing, professional, and collegial corporate culture with great events (company celebrations, croissant breaks, etc.)
* High team spirit, flat hierarchies, and varied tasks
* Beautiful workplace in the centre of Zurich with modern infrastructure
* Generous training budget including time for it as well as other attractive fringe benefits
Contact
If you have any questions, Federica Arcella, Lead Talent Acquisition Coordinator & Development, will be happy to assist you at talentacquisition@wuestpartner.com.

For data protection reasons, applications can only be accepted online.

What we do
RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 600+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain.

Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t spoil in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.
We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters, and growth is still accelerating. The first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

You own end-to-end recruiting for a designated set of Technology & Product teams (R&D, as we call it internally), operating as a strategic partner to the leaders you support. The job isn't just filling requisitions; it's raising the quality of every hiring decision made across those teams. Your area is clearly defined, but not a boundary: we work as one TA team, so you'll be expected to support colleagues on other areas and pick up wider TA work when priorities shift.
This is an AI-native role. You're expected to orchestrate AI across the recruiting lifecycle (sourcing, screening, deliverables, quality checks) and build the systems that make that possible.
It reports to the Head of Talent Acquisition, R&D. The role is ideally based in Finland, Sweden, or the UK, and the remit is global. Prior experience hiring into the US market isn't a requirement, but it's a big plus, as is a flexibility to work across those time zones if needed.

Own the full recruiting cycle for your Technology & Product teams, from role scoping to offer acceptance: delivering personally where it counts and drawing on TA colleagues and our RPO and consultancy partners where that gets a better result. You own the outcome either way, including the quality bar.
Build sourcing pipelines so key roles have engaged candidates before the urgency hits, and sell RELEX credibly to senior, passive candidates, closing offers in competitive markets.
Coach hiring managers on role definition, interview design, and selection, and how candidates are assessed: on evidence, through a process you keep sharpening.
Deliver market intelligence (talent availability, comp benchmarks, funnel metrics) and spot upcoming hiring needs early, so they're in the plan before they become urgent.
Design and run AI-native recruiting workflows, piloting new approaches and updating the standard based on evidence.
Work in collaboration with our colleagues, in eg. People Business Partner, Compensation, People Operations, and Employer Branding teams, connecting hiring to the wider employee lifecycle.
Take named ownership of initiatives that reach beyond your own teams, such as assessment frameworks, interview standards, AI workflows and drive them to global adoption, working through the wider TA team, People Business Partners, Compensation, and People Operations to make them stick.

s.h: What you'll bring to the table
s.t:
Business acumen and stakeholder influence. You understand how engineering and product organisations work and build credibility with their leaders, operating effectively across a global organization.
Full-cycle recruiting delivery. You've managed complex, niche, senior hires under time pressure without losing the quality bar, delivering directly, or alongside TA colleagues and delivery partners.
Proactive, global sourcing and talent attraction. You market-map and source actively across platforms and geographies instead of waiting for inbound, and you close senior hires against competing offers.
Hiring manager coaching and assessment quality. You guide hiring managers through scoping and calibration, and you challenge requirements when the evidence points elsewhere.
Data literacy and market insight. You use pipeline and funnel metrics to show hiring health and your own impact, and you present that comfortably to senior stakeholders.
AI orchestration and process improvement. You already work AI-first rather than doing recruiting tasks by hand, and you bring structure to ambiguity instead of waiting for someone else to define it. You're equally comfortable stepping outside your own remit when the team needs it, and you've owned work at a broader scope than your own patch.

You've designed something, driven it to adoption, and made it work for other people, in collaboration with TA colleagues, People Business Partners, Compensation, and People Operations.

Ownership of hiring outcomes for some of RELEX's most important Technology & Product teams, with real input into how that hiring gets done.

A financially robust company still growing fast, with the scale and stability to back the hiring you'll be driving.
Flexibility in how and where you work, and practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life.
Two paid volunteering days a year to spend on causes you care about.

Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.
Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.
Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

The Licensed Behavior Analyst (LBA) Recruiter is a specialized Human Resources professional responsible for sourcing, recruiting, and hiring qualified Licensed Behavior Analysts to support ABA therapy service delivery. This role goes beyond traditional recruitment; the LBA Recruiter serves as the primary HR partner, managing the full LBA lifecycle, from initial sourcing through credentialing, facilitation of Medicaid partnerships, and ongoing accreditation maintenance.
The LBA Recruiter works closely with BCBAs seeking LBA licensure, guides them through the accreditation process in partnership with LTE Care Plus, and ensures that all active LBAs maintain current credentials and Medicaid enrollment. This role requires a strong understanding of ABA licensure requirements in New York, Medicaid provider enrollment processes, and HRIS administration. The LBA Recruiter reports directly to the HR Director.

LBA Sourcing, Recruitment & Hiring
Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies to identify and attract qualified Licensed Behavior Analysts across NYC, Long Island, and Westchester County
Post and manage LBA job listings across relevant professional platforms, ABA networks, university partnerships, and licensure boards
Conduct initial outreach and screening calls to assess candidate qualifications, licensure status, and availability
Coordinate and facilitate the interview process in collaboration with the HR Director and clinical leadership
Extend offers and manage pre-hire documentation in accordance with LTE Care Plus HR policies
Maintain an active and sufficient LBA candidate pipeline to meet organizational service delivery needs without a gap
LBA Accreditation Support (BCBA to LBA Pathway)
Serve as the primary HR point of contact for BCBAs pursuing LBA licensure in New York State
Guide BCBA candidates through the LBA application and licensure process, including required documentation, application submission, and timeline expectations
Coordinate with the HR Director and clinical leadership to structure the organizational support provides to BCBAs seeking LBA accreditation
Track each BCBA's accreditation progress and maintain documentation of all steps completed
Ensure LBAs-in-process are not assigned to billable clinical roles until full licensure is confirmed
Medicaid Partnership Facilitation
Facilitate the Medicaid provider enrollment process for all incoming LBAs in partnership
Collect and submit all required documentation for Medicaid enrollment on behalf of newly hired LBAs
Track enrollment application status and follow up with Medicaid authorities or the LBA as needed to resolve delays
Maintain a complete record of each LBA's Medicaid enrollment status, effective dates, and provider identification numbers in the HRIS
Communicate enrollment timelines clearly to clinical operations to prevent unauthorized service delivery before enrollment confirmation
Escalate any enrollment denials, revalidations, or compliance issues to the HR Director immediately
Accreditation & Credential Maintenance
Maintain a master tracking system for all active LBA license expiration dates, Medicaid revalidation deadlines, and continuing education requirements
Send proactive renewal reminder communications to all LBAs no less than 90 days before any credential expiration
Follow up with LBAs who do not respond to renewal reminders and escalate to the HR Director if expiration risk remains unresolved
Remove or flag any LBA with a lapsed credential from active clinical assignment status immediately and notify the HR Director and operations team
Ensure zero active LBAs hold expired credentials at any point, maintain 100% compliance across the LBA workforce
Maintain organized and audit-ready credentialing files for every LBA in the HRIS
HRIS Administration
Enter all LBA new hire information into the HRIS on the same business day as hire confirmation
Update LBA records at each credentialing milestone, including LBA licensure confirmation, Medicaid enrollment, and credential renewals
Ensure all HRIS records are complete, accurate, and reflect the current status of each LBA's employment and credentialing
Run HRIS reports on LBA headcount, credential status, and pipeline metrics as requested by the HR Director
Identify and correct any data discrepancies in LBA records promptly
Ad Hoc HR Support
Complete additional tasks and special projects as assigned by the HR Director
Support HR operations during audits, regulatory reviews, or compliance initiatives involving LBA workforce documentation
Assist with the development of LBA onboarding materials, credential tracking tools, or process improvement initiatives as directed
Participate in HR team meetings and contribute to department-wide workflow improvements

High school diploma or GED required
Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field preferred
Minimum 2 years of experience in recruiting, credentialing, provider enrollment, or HR operations required
Prior experience in a healthcare, behavioral health, or ABA setting strongly preferred
Experience with Medicaid provider enrollment processes is highly preferred
Familiarity with New York State LBA licensure requirements and the BCBA-to-LBA pathway is a significant advantage
Prior HRIS administration experience required; experience with Zoho or similar platforms preferred
Skills & Competencies
Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple LBA credentialing timelines simultaneously
Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills for outreach to clinical professionals
High attention to detail and commitment to zero-defect credentialing records
Ability to manage sensitive professional and regulatory information with discretion
Self-directed with the ability to meet compliance deadlines without prompting
Understanding of ABA therapy service delivery and the clinical role of the LBA in a Medicaid funded service model
Proficiency with HRIS platforms, spreadsheet tracking tools, and professional communication platforms
